ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: Collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
source_title: Department of Financial Services — Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana Guidelines
geography_conditions: Available across all rural and urban areas in India.
special_conditions: Tarun Plus (loans >₹10 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh) is exclusively for entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid previous loans under the Tarun category.
Non-farm micro enterprise engaged in income-generating manufacturing, trading or service activities.
exclusions: Direct agricultural crop farming (allied activities like dairy, poultry, bee-keeping, grading, processing are eligible).
matching_reasons: Non-farm enterprise engaged in micro business / trade.
Loan requirement falls within institutional credit tier limits without requiring third-party collateral.
verification_required: Prior Tarun loan completion record (if applying for Tarun Plus > ₹10 Lakh).
Valid KYC, business quotation, and bank track record.
